{
  "name": "game-party",
  "displayName": "GAME MODE · Party",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "/party: each subagent of the session with ACTIVE, CLEAR or FAIL, a bar of its tool calls and its job; opens by itself when one starts on a wide terminal",
  "author": {
    "name": "Reason of Moon",
    "url": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods/tree/main/plugins/game-party",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "game-mode",
    "subagents",
    "agents",
    "pane"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "intensity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intensity",
      "description": "off draws nothing; casual draws the party; hardcore adds failed calls and run time",
      "default": "casual",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "casual",
        "hardcore"
      ]
    },
    "palette": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Palette",
      "description": "nes, gameboy and amber are made for dark terminals; theme follows your Claude Code theme (use it on a light background)",
      "default": "nes",
      "options": [
        "nes",
        "gameboy",
        "amber",
        "theme"
      ]
    },
    "autoOpen": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Open when a subagent starts",
      "description": "Open the pane by itself when the first subagent of a session starts (on terminals 144 columns wide or more)",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
